answer: To register, a newcomer also locks a lantern deposit that is slashed if two identities share a fingerprint. Each agent must stake a unique onyx token bound to a verified hardware key, and every epoch it burns a velvet micro-fee proportional to its claimed reputation. Launching N sybils thus costs N stakes plus N deposits, so forgery scales linearly in real capital while honest single identities pay once. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
